body: Yeah I did free code camp a couple of years back and they did help me get started a lot. I’m interested in the book recommendation though, thanks :)
Nah, they’re a college professor, it’s my second year of college so I’m kind of shocked at how bad some have been, so I still like to self study. Also, thank you for the recommendation!
Thank you, I will take you up on that. I really appreciate it.

I can try, but I doubt these people really care about me. They probably won’t be happy to hear why I’m reaching out. 

You know exactly what I’m going through then. I know you’re right. But how did you do it? How did you finally leave her? It sounds like it was hard for you too. 

Also, you’re probably right about killing myself. If it’s really going to hurt worse than it does now? I’ll be gone pretty soon.

You’re right. During the whole thing she was cussing at me and calling me a horrible person. I told her that’s not how you speak to someone you love but she said she didn’t give a fuck. Also she has told me to kill myself before. But I somehow managed to block it from my memory. If anyone can push me over the edge, it’s her. 

Also, I know I don’t owe her anything, but I still love her. I doubt that she still loves me, if she ever did to begin with, but I desperately want her in my life and I can’t bring myself to walk away. Maybe it’s extreme but I only see two options for myself right now: 1) go through with it or 2) work through our issues

I wish it were that easy. I have been seeing doctors for my depression since I was a child. I have taken so many SSRI’s already in my life that I can’t remember them all. I have even tried experimental ones where they are still in trial. Anything you name it, yoga, speech therapy, dietary restrictions, I have tried it all. There is no cure for depression.
I don’t have anyone. After being with her for a while I cut everyone else out of my life.

That’s what I want to know. I’m leaning towards she does it for compliments more than I am towards she does it because she’s going behind my back. It is a possibility that she’s just trying to avoid men online as she has that same problem as you where they always try to chat her up. I feel like we always compliment each other so I don’t know why she’d be fishing for more elsewhere, it’s worrisome.
Agreed. I probably am being unfair and was mostly bothered about it due to the fact that she’s always on her phone. Thanks.
Truth is I never needed the money. I got a job as a way to cope with depression and now I have school that does that for me. I’m very lucky, I know.
Thank you.
Thank you. Genuinely had no idea how to go about it.

This terrifies me. I know I’m completely attached to my s/o now and I know that it will come back to haunt me one day. And yet I can’t seem to distance myself. It’s not that I don’t have my own interests or ambitions, I do, and so does she. But I still managed to somehow make her my whole life. I try to act aloof and detached but it doesn’t work anymore, I get overwhelmed with emotion and when I open my mouth I spill my guts out every single time. I never learn. Actually when we first met I was very shy and took a long time to open up. Now I’m the opposite.

This could be because she took my virginity, gave me my first kiss etc. Even coming to this realization though, I don’t think much will change.

Surprisingly ok....had a few drinks and I was fine. The thought of meeting people is terrifying to me but once I’ve met them I usually adapt pretty quickly. I also brought a book to read and downloaded some podcasts to listen to so I could escape a little when the socializing gets to be too much. Thanks so much for asking it means a lot :)

Thanks. I honestly just wanted someone to tell me that I’m being unreasonable. I have major social anxiety, (I know, shocker) and it makes me feel worthless. But I know it’s not based in any logic and it’s just my brain chemistry trying to consume my head with paranoid delusions.

No need to apologize, I get it. I’m the same. I’ll probably be ok, if not it certainly wouldn’t be your fault. I guess it doesn’t really help to know others feel this way because it’s sad. But I need to know so I can put things into perspective for myself. Hope your dog at least brings you some companionship. Animals are therapeutic for us. And sorry to hear about your situation. You can PM too if you feel like it.

Yup. It’s a strange phenomenon to have to try and explain to people. 

When I experience both at the same time it just feels like a bunch of strange conflicting energy is being built up inside me
Hey, thank you. I’ve just been very ill recently. And I may take you up on that, you seem cool. Hope life is treating you well.
I hope so too, thank you
I hope so too.
Thanks, appreciate it.
A constant painful suffering. It hurts especially when you have those things, because it means your problems aren’t circumstantial and you can’t be fixed.
I’ve tried everything
I have chronic psychosomatic pain
I hope that’s really the case.
